document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Starvation sets in. Day after day, the two students stagger after 
you like wan ghosts. The hungry, inactive nights are the worst of 
all. As the three of you lie in misery on beds of cut boughs, you 
begin to believe there is a presence in camp—a thing of spirit 
that cannot be seen or touched.

The temperature drops precipitously, frosting the needles of 
the tamaracks around you.

Make a POW roll for each member of your party: first yourself, 
then Norman, then Sylvia. If your roll fails, go to 234. If Norman’s 
roll fails, go to 235. If Sylvia’s roll fails, go to 237. If all three rolls 
succeed, go to 198.
